$comment: One configuration for checking everything, and tsconfig.build.json for what ships.
The source is written with .ts import specifiers so Node can run it directly through
its own type stripping — `node src/cli.ts` needs nothing installed — while
rewriteRelativeImportExtensions makes the emitted JavaScript import .js. That is what
keeps `npm test` honest on a clean checkout, which is the property the cold-start
erasableSyntaxOnly is not decoration: it fails the build on syntax Node cannot strip
